description: Fetch a website's /llms.txt and check it against the llmstxt.org format: the H1 title, the summary block, the link sections, whether the listed links answer, and whether the server really sends the file rather than an HTML page. Returns a 0-100 score with findings; when the file is missing it says so. Use this when asked whether a site has an llms.txt, whether it is valid, or how to improve it. For a whole-store review use check_store_readiness, which only notes whether the file exists.

url.description: The website URL, e.g. "https://example.com". Any page of the site works; the file is read from the site root.

name: check_llms_txt
title: Check a site's llms.txt
